reason: Both are arithmetically sound and fully specified, but Output 1 wins on experimental design and priority logic: it sizes tests mobile-only with the traffic maths, runs delivery date and EMI/COD as a 2x2 that preserves each main effect's 11.9% MDE while exposing any clash, finishes in 8 weeks instead of 12, ranks the checkout-stage leaks above the thinly-evidenced trial line, and ships the event tracking the later tests need, whereas Output 2's 12-week calendar and trial-at-#2 ranking are less well grounded even though its delivered-orders-per-visitor metric for the COD test is the sharper commercial call.
